## Template Slide One: Model Overview

Agent-based modeling enables systematic testing of spatial interventions on neighborhood sorting dynamics.

* Street networks form local neighborhood connectivity, while expressways function as barriers[cite: 1, 2].
* Venues provide agents with alternative utility anchors outside immediate residential blocks[cite: 1, 2].
* Agents evaluate location utility using a weighted combination of neighbor composition and venue accessibility[cite: 1, 2].

## Template Slide Two: Findings and Directions

Simulations reveal critical divergences across geographic scales following amenity-based interventions[cite: 1].

* Localized venue placement alters meso-level cluster concentrations without changing macro indices[cite: 1].
* System-wide integrated placements fracture macro residential segregation enclaves[cite: 1].
* Interactive physicalizations translate simulation dynamics into tangible public exploranations[cite: 1, 2].
